# Deploy open models on Amazon SageMaker AI

<!-- This page is generated by scripts/generate-recipes.py from the recipes dataset. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Recipes are deployment configurations for open models from the Hugging Face Hub on Amazon SageMaker AI. Each recipe sets the instance type, the Hugging Face vLLM Deep Learning Container, and the engine settings, and was deployed and checked on SageMaker AI before being listed here. Each model page has a CloudFormation template that you can launch from the AWS console or with the AWS CLI, benchmark results where available, and the code to send requests.

To deploy from Python, see [Deploy a model](./deploy-a-recipe). To learn how recipes are checked and benchmarked, see [How deployments are benchmarked](./methodology).
